name: Agent Horny
source:
This game follows the story of a hotshot government Agent who has a simple goal: fuck up criminals and fuck beautiful women, and he'll do plenty of both. MC does have the habit of bending the rules to achieve what he wants and what he believes is right. While unraveling the plot of some powerful and brutal people he will have to decide how far he is willing to go to stop them.

[From Patreon]
translation:
本作讲述了一名风头正劲的政府特工的故事。他的目标很简单：狠狠收拾罪犯，再和漂亮女人上床，而这两件事，他一样都不会少干。主人公习惯变通规则，以得到自己想要的东西，践行他认定的正义。在揭露一群有权有势、残忍无情之人的阴谋时，他必须决定，为了阻止他们，自己愿意走到哪一步。

[摘自Patreon]
